messages:
liz: quick design review 1 compact role-cards on org settings. main question: show SSO control inline (chip/switch) or hide in overflow? mock in figma.
raj: compact cards are great for large orgs. prefer visible SSO state (chip) so admins can scan enforcement at a glance.
noah: accessibility/keyboard concern: chips must be real buttons (aria-pressed) and tabbable. overflow menus break discoverability for power users.
emma: a11y scan shows chip contrast ~3.2:1. need 4.5:1 for small text. Also ensure tooltip appears on focus.
a11y-bot: findings: chip contrast fail, menu items missing role attributes, dialog missing aria-describedby.
maya: product note: when toggling SSO on, we must surface affected users and provide a confirmation with an "I understand" checkbox. bulk toggles need per-role counts.
liz: copy idea: primary button label "Enable SSO for Admins" with supporting text "X users will be blocked until they set up SSO." modal links: View affected users, View in audit log.
noah: eng asks for deep-link format for audit: include role_id, action=ssotoggle, event_ts so audit page can open and focus the item. fallback: filtered list and toast.
raj: tiny UX: on mobile collapse to Invite + kebab (with menuitemcheckbox for SSO). desktop show chip + Invite.
emma: checklist: chip -> button + aria-pressed, tooltip on focus, modal focus trap, aria-describedby for affected list, contrast fix.
liz: action items: I'll update Figma with chip and overflow by EOD tomorrow. maya/noah to spec audit deep-link. raj to finalize modal copy. emma to run a11y re-scan after proto.
raj: +1 to visible chip and deep-link.
noah: +1 for button semantics.
emma: +1 for accessibility fixes.
a11y-bot: schedule re-scan when updated mock posted.
liz: thanks team :thumbsup:
